text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival arrived.
The moment Shinko Windy finished her event, she blurted out...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Next up,
we're gonna go crash the most hyped-up event!
choice_data_list: Huh, jumping in on the fly?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I don't have anything to do after this,
so I'm totally, terribly bored~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Just one event isn't enough for Windy-chan!
I gotta enter way more and get all the attention!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go find where the real fun is!
While browsing through all the festival stalls~~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch... Munch, munch...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, they're all pretty lively.
Now, which event is worthy of Windy-chan...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mmh...! What is that crowd of people...!?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Ohohoho!
Ohohoho! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ufufufufu♪
Looks like both of you are raring to go as well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
However, in this "carrot-eating race,"
I fully intend to take the victory~

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
A carrot-eating race!?
Like one of those bread-eating races!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: This is the oooone!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
There's a massive crowd, and
snapping up the competition is what I do best!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Windy-chan is gonna join in too!
Windy-chan is gonna win!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Windy-san!
Even if you just barge in out of nowhere like that...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is King Halo.
A highborn Umamusume who prides herself on being "first-class."
Though she has immense pride, she works just as hard to back it up.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wah-hah-hah-hah! Event hijack in progress!
Let Windy-chan participate too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Crashing the party, are we?
Why not, welcoooome!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is Seeking the Pearl.
A truly global and fabulous Umamusume.
Her potential is limitless...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind either.
We have spare carrots, after all.
It's a festival today, so it would be rather tasteless to stop them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And she is Grass Wonder.
A returnee Yamato Nadeshiko,
and an Umamusume of tremendous inner strength.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Grass-san...
Well, that's true enough.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Very well, challenge accepted!
A first-rate Umamusume must be able to defeat
even surprise walk-ins with absolute elegance!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! I'm gonna beat you to a pulp!
Windy-chan's got a secret plan~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And... the carrot-eating race has begun!
At the signal to start,
the Umamusume dash forward all at once.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Uryaryaryaaaa!!" its

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Shinko Windy breaks away early! Is she going with a Front Runner strategy today—!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe!
I'm gonna eat up all the carrots and ruin everyone else's day~~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"—*pant*, *wheeze*.
Time for the carrot, the carrot... right away..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*, *pant*... *cough*.
I went way too fast...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But this is no time to be exhausted...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ei, juuump!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez!
That's what happens when you bite into it in such a rush...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Here, look down!
I'll pat your back...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Windy! Calm down!
Say, "Achoo"!!
Repeat after me!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, my, my...! Ah, you threw it up, didn't you?
You'll be alright now~.
choice_data_list: Windy! Get a hold of yourself!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Revived with everyone's help,
Shinko Windy tried to stage a comeback from there, but..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ended up second to last, I did...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It ended in a disappointing result,
but the bizarre incident caused a little stir.
It seems... we did manage to stand out a bit?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Trailing in the rear is Shinko Windy!
She's falling a bit behind, could this be part of the plan?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Fufufu!
Windy-chan never rushes!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(What matters most in this race
is simply "bite force"!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Kh! Fresh carrots...!
They're way harder than I thought!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What is this?! It won't come off at all!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Aah, the string is spinning around and around...
Where am I supposed to bite down on it...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Hop hop! Hop hop!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Looks like everyone is struggling!
Unlike bread, it doesn't tear off easily at all~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... Everything is going just as planned.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Having bitten at everything in the universe on a daily basis,
Windy-chan saw this coming from a mile away...!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: "First, I'll spot the carrot that looks easiest to bite into, then line up my angle... right here...!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *Chomp!!*

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Number 2, Shinko Windy, makes her move here!
She snatches the carrot in one go and daaaashes away!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
*Crunch, crunch! Gobble, gobble!*
—*Gulp!!*

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm heading out first~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy takes 1st!
Our last-minute entrant walks away as the champion~~!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wah-hah-hah-hah! Wah-hah-hah-hah!
An overwhelming victory for Windy-chan~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Aweeesome!
Congrats on 1st place! That was so fun~!
So cute~! What a great bite that was~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hm-hmm~♪
They're watching... ev-ery-one is watching...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Windy-chan is standing out super-duper much! Yay yay yaaay!
